isFree.question: Is Chawso PDF really free?
isFree.answer: Yes, absolutely. All tools on Chawso PDF are 100% free to use, with no file limits, no sign-ups, and no watermarks. We believe everyone deserves access to simple, powerful PDF tools without a paywall.

areFilesSecure.question: Are my files secure? Where are they processed?
areFilesSecure.answer: Chawso PDF is designed to process your files locally in your web browser. The tools are not built to upload your documents to our servers for processing, and processed copies are saved by your browser directly to your device. The security of your documents also depends on your own device and browser.

platforms.question: Does it work on Mac, Windows, and Mobile?
platforms.answer: Yes! Chawso PDF's tools are designed to run in your browser, so they work on any operating system with a modern web browser, including Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

gdprCompliant.question: Is Chawso PDF GDPR compliant?
gdprCompliant.answer: Chawso PDF is designed so that the tools process your files locally in your browser, and the service is not intended to see their content. The hosting and content-delivery providers that serve the site receive standard connection metadata (such as your IP address and request URLs); see the privacy policy for details.

dataStorage.question: Do you store or track any of my files?
dataStorage.answer: The tools are designed to process your files in your browser memory, and processed copies are saved by your browser directly to your device. The service is not designed to store, track, or log your files; see the privacy policy for what the hosting providers receive.

different.question: What makes Chawso PDF different from other PDF tools?
different.answer: Most PDF tools upload your files to a server for processing. Chawso PDF never does that. We use secure, modern web technology to process your files directly in your browser. This means faster performance, stronger privacy, and complete peace of mind.

browserBased.question: How does browser-based processing keep me safe?
browserBased.answer: By processing files locally in your browser, Chawso PDF is designed to keep your documents on your own device rather than sending them to a server for processing.

analytics.question: Do you use cookies or analytics to track me?
analytics.answer: Chawso PDF does not require an account, and the site is designed to operate without analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts. Like any website, the hosting and content-delivery providers that serve the pages receive standard connection metadata such as your IP address and request URLs; see the privacy policy for details.

support.title: Like My Work?
support.description: Chawso PDF is a passion project, built to provide a free, private, and powerful PDF toolkit for everyone. If you find it useful, consider supporting its development. Every coffee helps!

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine whole files, or select specific pages to merge into a new document.
fileModeInstructions: Click and drag the icon to change the order of the files.
In the "Pages" box for each file, you can specify ranges (e.g., "1-3, 5") to merge only those pages.
Leave the "Pages" box blank to include all pages from that file.
pageModeInstructions: All pages from your uploaded PDFs are shown below.
Simply drag and drop the individual page thumbnails to create the exact order you want for your new file.

mission.title: Our
mission.description: To provide the most comprehensive PDF toolbox that respects your privacy and never asks for payment. We believe essential document tools should be accessible to everyone, everywhere, without barriers.

philosophy.label: Our Core Philosophy
philosophy.title: Privacy First. Always.
philosophy.description: Chawso PDF's tools are designed to run locally in your browser: the service is not intended to see the content of your documents, and the site is designed to operate without tracking what you do.

speed.title: Built for Speed
speed.description: There's no upload or download step. Files are processed right in your browser using WebAssembly, so you're never waiting on a server.

free.title: Free to Use
free.description: Every tool is free, with no trials, no subscriptions and no watermarks. Development is funded by commercial licenses.

noAccount.title: No Account Required
noAccount.description: Open any tool and start right away. No email, no password, no personal information.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: The code is public on GitHub under AGPL-3.0, so you can check exactly how your files are handled. It builds on open-source projects like PDF.js, pdf-lib, qpdf and LibreOffice.
